rules.name: Sector hierarchy closure
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A niche is in the thesis when one of its ancestors is a fund focus area and none is excluded.

rules.name: Thesis fit
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Eligible companies earn thesis points.

rules.name: EBITDA band
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Points when EBITDA sits in the core band.

rules.name: Margin benchmark
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Points when margin beats the focus-area benchmark.

rules.name: CFO from a PE-backed company
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Recent CFO hire who came from a sponsor-backed employer.

rules.name: Sponsor exit window
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Sponsor has held long enough and the fund is old enough to sell.

rules.name: Banker engaged
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A banker engagement signal in the recent window.

rules.name: Debt maturity
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Debt matures inside the window.

rules.name: Succession signal
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Long-tenured founder CEO with no President or COO.

rules.name: New independent director
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A new board seat in the last year.

rules.name: Recent positive CRM touch
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A positive CRM interaction in the window.

rules.name: Warm path access
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Targets within two hops earn access points.

rules.name: Cross-fund conflict
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A target that trades with a Fund III company is flagged.

rules.name: Tenure overlap
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Two people overlapped at the same organization for a year or more.

rules.name: Board co-service
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Two people served on the same board for a year or more.

rules.name: Deal co-participation
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Two people worked the same transaction.

rules.name: Positive CRM contact
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Our person had positive meetings with the other person.

rules.name: Shared employer is not a tie
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Same employer at different times is not a relationship.

rules.name: Warm path search
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Shortest hop distance from our people over the relationship graph.

rules.name: Commercial link
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A supplier and customer relationship.

rules.name: Add-on similarity
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Share of customers and suppliers in common with the platform.

rules.name: Whitespace states
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. States the candidate operates in that the platform does not.

rules.name: Deal-flow centrality
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. How often an intermediary sits on the shortest route between parties.

rules.name: Coverage gap
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A top-decile intermediary we rarely talk to.

rules.name: Fund ownership
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A fund currently owns the company.

rules.name: Sector concentration guideline
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. Fund exposure to one sector stays under the guideline.

rules.name: Current role
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A person holds a role at an organization.

rules.name: Closest intermediary
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. The intermediary with the most recent tie to a cold target.

rules.name: Current holding
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A company a fund of ours owns today, not one it used to own.

rules.name: Portfolio exposure
rules.docstring: FIXTURE. A current holding within two commercial hops of the target, classified by fund.
